summary: Apply finite material research caps before rejecting oversized recipe headroom.
details: A valid finite maximum can bound a qualified level-four continuation even when upstream recipe headroom would exceed the technology level domain.
Unbounded or out-of-domain effective maxima still withhold the continuation. Missing recipes, invalid effects, explicit legacy-only caps and recipe saturation retain their existing dispositions.
Technology and setting identities, early-stage behavior, effect increments, cost policy and material-route admission remain preserved.
Controlled progression and planner regressions cover the boundary and F200/F210 prototype strategies. Exact native package and save qualification remains pending.
